shared_elements: low-relief carving with broad rounded raised bands defined by incised outlines
stylized profile head with headdress-like element
eye rendered as an oval/circle within a surrounding form
rectilinear panel or plaque-like framing of a composite motif
justification: Both surfaces present a single composite motif in shallow relief built from broad, rounded raised bands with incised contours, and both appear to include a stylized profile head with an ear-ornament/headdress element and an oval eye, plus curvilinear scrollwork. However, A is dominated by dense interlocking spirals and scroll clusters filling the whole field with no legible whole figure, whereas B shows a clear, uncluttered profile bust with shoulder/cape striations, so the composition and legibility differ markedly.
